records.question: How does BEC organize campus placement recruitment?
records.answer: The supplied placement policy says campus recruitment is organized in priority slots based on CTC bands. The Training and Placement Office manages the process.

records.question: What is Slot 1 in the BEC placement policy?
records.answer: Slot 1 is the Super Dream Offer slot for companies offering CTC of ₹8 lakh per annum or above. It is scheduled for 3–4 days in Week 1. Students selected in this slot are de-registered from the remaining placement process.

records.question: What is Slot 2 in the BEC placement policy?
records.answer: Slot 2 is the Dream Offer slot for companies offering CTC from ₹5.5 lakh to ₹7.99 lakh per annum. It is scheduled for 5–6 days in Week 2. Students selected here can accept one offer and will be de-registered.

records.question: What is Slot 3 in the BEC placement policy?
records.answer: Slot 3 is the Standard Offer slot for companies offering CTC from ₹3 lakh to ₹5.49 lakh per annum. It is scheduled for 10–15 days across Weeks 3 and 4. Students selected in this slot remain eligible for higher-priority slots according to the rules.

records.question: What is Slot 4 in the BEC placement policy?
records.answer: Slot 4 is for core or product companies with any CTC. These companies can participate at a time convenient to the college and company. A student may select either their highest offer or a core/product company offer.
